items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: and Lou Levy, the boss of the publishing company, said, “Toots, you got your foot in the door now, man.

ctx.x: Publisher. I was lucky to be with an honest publishing company, because some of the guys… you [were?], put your name there, you know. And yes, that was Lou Levy, Leeds Music. Bluesette was with Duchess Music. But then, I had written a song, and Lou Levy, the boss of the publishing company, said, “Toots, you got your foot in the door now, man. Write, write, write, write and bring it to me.” [laughs] You know. [laughs] And I said, “Okay.” And then, in those days, maybe you remember… they had things with two…
